title: Inference-time decomposition of activations (ITDA) (real LM activations)
description: Build the dictionary from real activation examples with no gradient training: stream through activations, reconstruct each with matching pursuit over the current dictionary, and add the example as a new atom when the reconstruction is poor. The paper reports SAE-like quality at a small fraction of the cost. Prediction: recovers planted features at least as well as a tuned TopK SAE. Same idea and prediction as on the toy testbed, now on Pythia-70M activations with planted features, the scale these methods were designed for.

source.title: Inference-Time Decomposition of Activations (ITDA): A Scalable Approach to Interpreting Large Language Models
